title: Wonders of Japan | A Journey Through Timeless Sights
highlights: Discover the cultural essence of Japan as you journey through Kyoto, Tokyo, and Osaka, experiencing a blend of ancient traditions and urban attractions.
Ride the Hakone Ropeway for sweeping views of Mt. Fuji, Lake Ashi, and the sulfurous Owakudani Valley, home to natural hot springs.
Spend a fun-filled day at Tokyo Disneyland, enjoying thrilling rides, Disney parades, and meeting iconic characters from your favorite movies.
Enjoy panoramic views from the Tokyo Skytree observation deck, where you can see the entire city skyline and Mt. Fuji on clear days.
Visit Kinkaku-ji Temple, once a retirement villa, now a UNESCO World Heritage site, showcasing the grandeur of 14th-century architecture and Zen culture.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the tour/premises.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
Bring a portable charger for your devices, as power outlets may be scarce. Carry an adapter for Type A or Type B sockets.
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, traditional house or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
It's not customary to leave a tip for your server in Japan, as tipping isn't a standard practice in restaurants here.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Upon arrival at Narita Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in & spend the rest of the day at your leisure. You can visit the bustling Shibuya Crossing, one of the busiest intersections in the world, or the Tsukiji Hongan-ji Temple, famous for its unique blend of Indian-inspired architecture. In the evening, you can wander around the Omotesando area, known for its tree-lined streets and shops. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Start your day by heading to the pick-up point- LOVE Sculpture. Board your transfer & explore places like Meiji Jingu Shrine, Imperial Palace & Japan National Stadium. Continue to explore Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo's oldest temple, & Tokyo Tower, once the tallest building in Japan. Also, explore the Odaiba District, perfect for shopping. Conclude your tour with panoramic city views from Tokyo Skytree. Afterwards, get driven to 1-chōme-7-2 Nishishinjuku. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Excursion To Mount Fuji and Hakone
days.desc: Today, enjoy a day trip to Mt. Fuji and Hakone. Begin by heading to the meeting point-Giulio Paolini Sculpture: "Kaleidoscorpio", then get driven to 5th Station of Mt. Fuji for views of Fuji Five Lakes. Next, board Hakone ropeway, which offers scenic views of Lake Ashi and Mt. Fuji. Explore the Owakudani Valley, known for its geothermal activity & later, get driven to Odawara Station. From there, take the Shinkansen bullet train back to Tokyo Station, where you can head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour From Tokyo - Return via Bullet Train with Lunch
Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Get ready to embark on a full day trip to Tokyo Disneyland. Start by getting transferred to the park, where you can explore its seven themed areas, including the World Bazaar, Tomorrowland, Adventureland, and Fantasyland with Cinderella Castle as its centerpiece. You can also enjoy iconic attractions like "Space Mountain", "Pirates of the Caribbean" and "It's a Small World," as well as spectacular parades and fireworks. After a fun filled day, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Tokyo Disneyland Tickets - Admission Tickets to Tokyo Disneyland

days.title: Day Trip to Tokyo Disneysea
days.desc: In the morning, make your way to Tokyo DisneySea, the world’s only sea-themed Disney park. Discover its seven themed ports, from the Mediterranean Harbor to the mysterious Arabian Coast. Experience thrilling rides like "Tower of Terror" and "Journey to the Center of the Earth", a thrilling underground expedition. Enjoy spectacular live shows that bring Disney’s magic to life and meet iconic characters like Mickey and Minnie. After a fun filled day, return to your hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Disney Sea Tickets - Tokyo DisneySea 1-Day Passport

days.title: Leisure Day in Tokyo
days.desc: Spend this day at leisure, where you can either relax or explore Tokyo on your own. You can visit the Edo-Tokyo Museum, which offers a fascinating look into Tokyo’s transformation from a small fishing village to a bustling metropolis. You can even enjoy a relaxing stroll in Ritsurin Garden. In the evening, you can head to the Kabuki-za Theatre, where you can watch Kabuki theater, a centuries-old form of Japanese drama. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check out & head to Tokyo Station on your own to board the bullet train to Kyoto. Upon your arrival, make your way to the hotel, check in, and enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. You can visit Nijo Castle, famous for its "nightingale floors" that chirp when walked on. Alternatively, you can explore the Kyoto National Museum, showcasing traditional art, or the Kyoto International Manga Museum, a paradise for manga lovers. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin your day by heading to the pick-up point, Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit. Board your transfer for the Kyoto & Nara sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the Kinkaku-ji Temple, home to the Golden Pavilion, a masterpiece of Zen architecture. Continue to Arashiyama District, where you can stroll through the famous bamboo grove. Next, visit Nara Park, where you can interact with the free-roaming deer. Later, you'll be driven Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full-Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara - Kyoto Departure/Buffet Lunch

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Lesiure
days.desc: Post check out, make your way to the Kyoto Station and board a bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, head to the hotel and check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can visit the iconic Osaka Castle or the Shitennō-ji Temple, Japan's oldest Buddhist temple. In the evening, you can visit the Floating Garden Observatory, located in the Umeda Sky Building, where you can capture stunning panoramic views of the city’s skyline. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, you'll be driven to explore Universal Studios. Step into Minion Park, the largest in the world, where you can enjoy thrilling rides and meet your favorite Disney characters. Experience heart-pounding adventures in Jurassic Park, home to the WaterWorld show and the exciting Flying Dinosaur ride. Don’t miss The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, where you can explore Hogwarts Castle and shop for magical merchandise. Afterward, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour | Leisure Time
days.desc: Begin your day by heading to the Osaka Tourist Information Center, the starting point of your guided walking tour. Visit Shinsekai, a retro district with the iconic Tsutenkaku Tower, and explore Hozenji Yokocho, a charming alley housing the Hozenji Temple. Stroll through the vibrant Dotonbori District & capture stunning views of the Dotonbori Canal from Ebisu Bridge. After the tour, you can explore Osaka on your own, visiting attractions like the Tennoji Park, or the bustling Umeda District.

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Take this day at your own pace, where you can choose to relax or explore Osaka on your own. You can visit Miraiza Osaka-jo, a cultural complex near Osaka Castle offering unique dining and shopping experiences. You can even head to Abeno Harukas, Japan’s tallest skyscraper, for panoramic city views from its observation deck. Afterward, you can visit other sites such as Hokoku Shrine, Shinsekai District or the Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan. Post sightseeing, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Kansai International Airport, where your trip comes to an end.
